experiments.name: scale_x_first
experiments.prediction: Move the owner-x store before the constant y store.
experiments.observed_prediction: All nine differences disappear while six unrelated contributions remain frozen.
experiments.falsifier: Any remaining raw difference or changed surrounding contribution.

experiments.name: spawn_independent_checks
experiments.prediction: Keep each child null check and callback inside its own spawn_normal branch.
experiments.observed_prediction: Two independent direct calls and the target call/test graph return.
experiments.falsifier: The compiler still merges calls or the relocation-resolved control-flow topology differs.

experiments.name: particle_index_lifetime
experiments.prediction: Initialize n after the discarded random_limit(4) call.
experiments.observed_prediction: EDI is free for the original early z-value allocation.

experiments.name: particle_separate_sound_arms
experiments.prediction: Spell out repeated natural-C sound call arms for each switch value.
experiments.observed_prediction: A 404-byte code body and ten-entry pointer table match the target destinations.
experiments.falsifier: The compiler retains a byte map or the candidate table destinations/branch body differ.

experiments.name: combined_index_lifetime
experiments.prediction: Combine the three initial prepared forms.
experiments.observed_prediction: All three independent changes compose while peer contributions remain frozen.
experiments.falsifier: A changed peer contribution, semantic failure, or a candidate contribution regresses.

experiments.name: best_combined
experiments.prediction: Combine the scale reorder, independent spawn tails, delayed index lifetime, and separate sound arms.
experiments.observed_prediction: Two contributions become raw exact; spawn topology and the ten-entry switch table become diagnostic matches without peer changes.
experiments.falsifier: Any raw-exact leaf regresses, the table destinations differ, a peer contribution changes, or semantics fail.

experiments.name: loop_counter_before_rng
experiments.prediction: Initialize loop index before discarded RNG call to match remaining setup order.
experiments.falsifier: Remaining full-span diagnostic differences or any changed peer.
experiments.observed: All 448 bytes including table equal diagnostically; 84 raw differences remain at relocations.
